officialText:
Section 760.176 – Revise Section 760.176(G) to read as follows:

(G)NPLFA Cable Markings. Non-power-limited fire alarm circuit cables shall be permitted to be marked with a maximum usage voltage rating of 150 volts. Cables that are listed for circuit integrity shall be identified with the suffix “CI” as defined in 760.176(F).
